_meta.description: City-metric-months that keep their current (pre-pipeline) value. apply_climate_air.py leaves these numbers unchanged and marks their provenance 'Editorial estimate', confidence low, with the reason as the note.
_meta.seededBy: scripts/seed_holdbacks.py (rules in its docstring); edit MANUAL there for hand additions

rules.pending: ERA5 not fetched (quota) and no high-confidence station
rules.who-scale: CAMS->WHO factor outside [0.6, 2.0] with no cited override
rules.highland: highland city without station: humidity and night lows
rules.shape: PM2.5 seasonal pattern correlates < -0.3 with a previous pattern spanning >= 10 µg/m³ (no override)
rules.material: non-high-confidence value differs materially from the previous one
